text_block_list.name: Event Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—And our next mock race will be held over 1800m on turf.
With track conditions roughed up by last night's rain, how will this race unfold?!

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text:
One, two, three, four! Two, two, three, go!
Three, two, three, four! Four, two, three, go!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today was the day of the mock race. The field was stacked with
formidable opponents like Mihono Bourbon and Rice Shower.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For better or worse, Machikane Tannhauser wasn't the standout type.
I assumed the crowd wouldn't expect much in the way of a victory, but—

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Machitan's running!
I heard she was amazing during that Cops and Robbers training game.

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text: Right? She was keeping right up with Bourbon and Rice's training routines too!
choice_data_list: (People actually have high hopes for her...!)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
It seems Tannhauser-san's steady accumulation of
"pleasantly surprising" performances is gradually winning people over.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Machitaaan! Do your best!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Following Twin Turbo's lead, the surrounding Umamusume
also began shouting words of encouragement for Machikane Tannhauser.

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, that's a lot of cheering!
...Alright, I'm gonna give it my all! I'm def-i-nite-ly... gonna win!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Shouldering everyone's expectations, the mock race got underway.
However—

text_block_list.name: Event Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Mihono Bourbon has a lead of 5, 6, 7 lengths!
The battle for second place is in total disarray!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Down the final stretch. Mihono Bourbon opens up a massive lead,
and while Rice Shower puts up a valiant fight, Machikane Tannhauser simply cannot find an extra gear—

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text: Mihono Bourbon takes the lead! And crosses the line with an overwhelming victory!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
Machitan kinda fell short of expectations, huh...?
She didn't really get a moment to shine before it was all over.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While applause erupted for Mihono Bourbon, an awkward, disappointed atmosphere
sprang up among the girls who had placed high hopes on Machikane Tannhauser.
choice_data_list: (With everyone expecting so much from her... I hope she's okay.)

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Pheeew, sorry about that, Trainer!
Guess I've still got a long, long way to go~.

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Maybe the turf caught my legs or something?
My muscles definitely weren't up to snuff. ...Somehow...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A lackluster result after carrying so many expectations. She must be in shock.
Just as I was thinking of heading back to the trainer's office to console her—

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text:
All that running made me hungry! I'm off to the cafeteria!
Mmhmm, what should I get? I'm totally feeling udon today~.

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text: Down the hatch!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Completely ignoring my worries, Machikane Tannhauser ordered a normal lunch
and began digging in, without even mentioning the race.

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Is something wrong, Trainer?
You look kind of spaced out.
choice_data_list: Well, I just figured you'd be brooding over the loss...

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text: Brooding? ...Over what?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: She seemed completely oblivious, so I chose my words carefully to explain—

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I get it! Well, sure, of course I was bummed out that I lost,
but... all that means is that I'm just not strong enough yet.

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text:
So... yeah, I'm not really brooding at all~.
Though I am thinking I should rework my self-training routine!

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ooh! This carrot is suuuper yummy!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ahhh, I totally get it.

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text: Oh, hey guys~! ...Wait, get what?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
How your Trainer feels.
You were just thinking, 'How can she be so ordinary...?' weren't you?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Even when other girls get all tense or crushed by pressure,
Tannhauser stays cooompletely calm and normal!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Even when things don't go her way, she doesn't cry. She stays positive.
...Didn't you catch glimpses of that during training?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Now that they mentioned it, looking back—

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, don't worry, I'm totally fine!
My legs are just shaking a bit. ...Guess I've still got a ways to go~.

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
No way, you kept up with them until the last 300 meters, didn't you?
That's plenty impressive already.

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text:
*pant* *gasp* *pant*...!
No waaay~, I can't just give up~! Come on, work with me here~!

text_block_list.name: Thief Team Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
It's been almost 20 minutes now. If someone chased me down for that long,
I'd definitely be feeling totally cornered...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Machikane Tannhauser had remained 'ordinary' through it all.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
It's actually pretty amazing, but almost nobody ever notices.
Even she doesn't really realize it.

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text: Wait, huh? Are you praising me right now?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: She might be a handful like this, but please take good care of Tannhauser, okay?

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text: Whoaaa... You guys sound just like my parents~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Setting 'parents' aside... I felt like I had finally begun to understand
what made Machikane Tannhauser so quietly remarkable.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An unshakeable composure that gives her the strength to keep marching forward without faltering.
Without anyone realizing it, she possessed a truly rare gift.
